sections.title: Weekly, Bi-Weekly, or One-Time Mowing
sections.text: Choose a mowing schedule around grass growth and the condition of the yard. Faster growth may call for weekly visits, while slower growth may suit a longer interval. If the property has become overgrown, describe the current height when requesting a one-time cut. The first visit can involve different work from keeping an already maintained lawn on a recurring schedule.

sections.title: What Goes Into a Lawn Mowing Price?
sections.text: Mowing has a $50 minimum. Larger properties typically run $95–$135 per acre, depending on terrain, obstacles, and grass height. The mowable area matters more than the total parcel size. Include gate access, fences, trees, steep sections, and anything that needs extra trimming so Eli can provide a free estimate for the actual job.

faqs.q: Does mowing include trimming and cleanup?
faqs.a: Yes. The mowing service includes trimming around trees, fences, beds, and structures, plus clearing grass clippings from hard surfaces. Additional landscape or leaf cleanup can be included in a separate scope.

faqs.q: Can I get a mowing estimate without a contract?
faqs.a: Yes. Estimates are free, and both one-time and recurring service are available without a contract. Send the address, approximate lawn size, and preferred frequency, or call or text Eli to discuss the property.

sections.title: Start With the Beds That Need Attention
sections.text: An overgrown bed may need cleanup and preparation before fresh material will make a lasting difference. Describe the existing weeds, debris, shrubs, and mulch or rock in the area you want improved. Eli can review the scope and discuss bed reshaping, shrub trimming, and new material as part of a property-specific landscaping estimate.

sections.title: Plan a Cleanup or a Larger Outdoor Project
sections.text: A seasonal bed cleanup and a larger landscaping installation involve different preparation and material costs. Photos, approximate bed dimensions, and a description of the finished look you want help define the work. Travel beyond the normal service area is available for larger projects, subject to the job and scheduling. There is no flat online price for landscaping; the estimate is free.

faqs.q: Can bed cleanup be combined with mulch or rock installation?
faqs.a: Yes. Ask to include preparation and the new material in the same estimate. Eli can discuss the area, your material preference, and the cleanup needed before installation.

faqs.q: Do you provide commercial landscaping estimates?
faqs.a: Yes. ET's Lawn Care & More works with residential and commercial properties. Share the property address, access details, and the areas you want included to request a free estimate.

sections.title: Leaf Removal From the Lawn and Landscape Beds
sections.text: A lawn covered with loose leaves is a different cleanup from wet leaves packed into shrub beds or along a fence. Include both areas in your request, along with any light yard debris you want removed. Leaf collection and removal can be quoted as a one-time job; photos help show the amount of material and access for the cleanup.

sections.title: Fall and Spring Yard Cleanup Pricing
sections.text: Leaf and seasonal cleanups start at $150. Final pricing depends on property size, the volume and condition of material, and the work needed in beds as well as on the lawn. If leaves are still falling, discuss whether you want one cleanup or help at more than one point in the season. Heavy or hazardous storm work needs a separate discussion of the scope.

faqs.q: Are leaf cleanups available as a one-time service?
faqs.a: Yes. One-time leaf removal and seasonal property cleanups are available for homes and commercial properties. Request a free estimate and include the address and areas you want cleared.

faqs.q: Does the starting price apply to every yard?
faqs.a: No. The $150 figure is a starting price. Leaf volume, property size, access, and the amount of bed and lawn cleanup determine the final estimate before work begins.

sections.title: Help for Compacted Soil and Thin Grass
sections.text: Core aeration removes small plugs of soil to create space for air and water. Overseeding adds grass seed to an existing lawn to help fill thin areas. Tell Eli about bare patches, foot traffic, shade, and areas where water does not soak in readily so the estimate addresses the lawn's condition rather than acreage alone.

sections.title: Discuss Timing and Follow-Up Care
sections.text: Scheduling depends on grass type, weather, and the work the lawn needs. When asking about overseeding, include how the lawn will be watered afterward and any recent lawn treatments. Eli can discuss seasonal availability and a property-specific estimate. Mowing, fertilization, and weed-control work should be coordinated with the seeding plan rather than booked independently without that context.

faqs.q: Can I request aeration without overseeding?
faqs.a: Yes. Tell Eli whether you want core aeration, overseeding, or both. The estimate is based on lawn size, access, and the condition of the grass and soil.

faqs.q: What does aeration and overseeding cost?
faqs.a: There is no single published price for every lawn. Send the property address and approximate grass area for a free estimate tailored to the work required.

sections.title: A Treatment Estimate for Your Existing Lawn
sections.text: A useful lawn-treatment conversation starts with the grass you have and the problems you want addressed. Mention persistent weeds, thin areas, shade, and any recent applications. Fertilization and weed-control options are quoted for the property so you can discuss the lawn's needs and the service scope before scheduling.

sections.title: Coordinate Treatments With Other Lawn Work
sections.text: If you also want mowing, aeration, or overseeding, include those plans in the estimate request. Timing needs to account for the work already scheduled and any products recently used on the lawn. Ask Eli about the proposed service, preparation, and follow-up instructions, including when treated areas can be used again.

faqs.q: Can lawn treatments be discussed with my mowing estimate?
faqs.a: Yes. Select fertilization and weed control along with mowing on the estimate form. Eli can discuss the services and their scheduling together.

faqs.q: Is fertilization priced per property?
faqs.a: Yes. Request a free estimate with the address, approximate lawn size, and the issues you want addressed. Treatment pricing is based on the property and proposed work.

sections.title: Refresh Beds With the Material You Want
sections.text: Mulch and decorative rock create different looks and maintenance needs. Include photos of the existing bed and the material you are considering when requesting an estimate. Eli can discuss the area, material choice, and preparation needed so the quote reflects the whole installation rather than only spreading new material.

sections.title: Preparation and Access Affect the Estimate
sections.text: Bed size, existing material, cleanup, and the distance material must be moved all affect the work. Mention narrow gates, steps, or beds that cannot be reached easily from a driveway. If shrubs also need trimming or the bed needs reshaping, include those requests so preparation and installation can be considered together.

faqs.q: Can you clean the beds before installing material?
faqs.a: Yes. Bed preparation and cleanup are available to include in the project. Describe the existing conditions when requesting your free estimate.

faqs.q: What information helps price mulch or rock installation?
faqs.a: Send the address, approximate bed dimensions, photos, and your preferred material if known. Include any existing material you want addressed and access limitations.

sections.title: Shrub and Hedge Care With Clipping Cleanup
sections.text: Shrub trimming can make an entrance, foundation bed, or business frontage look more cared for. Tell Eli which shrubs or hedge sections need attention and whether you want light shaping or an overgrown area evaluated. Trimming includes clipping cleanup, with the scope agreed for the plants and access at your property.

sections.title: Quote the Landscape Details Together
sections.text: If the beds below the shrubs are also full of leaves or need fresh material, ask about combining the work with a bed cleanup or mulch installation. Photos and approximate hedge height help show the amount of trimming involved. One-time and seasonal service can be discussed for residential and commercial properties.

faqs.q: Is clipping cleanup included?
faqs.a: Yes. Shrub trimming includes cleaning up the clippings. Ask Eli to include any additional bed or yard cleanup in the estimate.

faqs.q: Can I get a quote for just shrub trimming?
faqs.a: Yes. You can request a stand-alone trimming estimate or combine it with mowing and landscaping. Send photos and the address for a free estimate.

sections.title: Small Paver and Outdoor Improvement Projects
sections.text: Start with how you want to use the space and the area you want improved. Photos, approximate dimensions, and examples of the material or layout you prefer help Eli review the proposed project. Pavers and small hardscape improvements are quoted individually because preparation and access vary from one property to the next.

sections.title: Review the Site Before Choosing the Scope
sections.text: Existing surfaces, changes in elevation, and the way people access the area can affect the preparation and layout. Include those details in your request rather than relying on a square-foot price alone. Landscaping and hardscaping can be discussed together, with travel available for larger jobs subject to the project and schedule.

faqs.q: Do you publish a flat paver installation price?
faqs.a: No. Materials, site preparation, access, and project size determine the quote. Request a free custom estimate for the space you have in mind.

faqs.q: Can I include landscaping in a paver project estimate?
faqs.a: Yes. Describe the full outdoor project, including any bed cleanup, mulch, or rock work, so Eli can review the services together.

sections.title: Ask About Winter Availability Before You Need It
sections.text: Snow-removal service depends on the address, snowfall, property access, and scheduling. Include the drive, walks, or access areas you need cleared when contacting Eli. Availability must be confirmed for the property; sending an estimate request does not reserve a service time or promise an emergency response.

sections.title: Describe the Areas That Need Clearing
sections.text: A short residential drive and a commercial access area involve different amounts of work. Share the approximate size, parked vehicles, slopes, and any narrow areas that affect access. Pricing is based on the property and snowfall, with a free estimate and direct communication before work is arranged.

faqs.q: Is same-day snow removal guaranteed?
faqs.a: No. Contact Eli to confirm current availability, the property scope, and scheduling. Service depends on conditions and the route.

faqs.q: Can commercial properties request snow removal?
faqs.a: Yes. Residential and commercial snow-removal estimates are available. Include the address and areas to be cleared so availability and pricing can be confirmed.

sections.title: Match the Cleaning Plan to the Surface
sections.text: Send photos and identify the exterior surfaces you want cleaned when requesting pressure washing. Surface material, condition, and access help determine whether the work is suitable and what preparation may be needed. Eli evaluates the property before providing an estimate rather than assuming the same cleaning approach fits every surface.

sections.title: One-Time Cleaning With Other Outdoor Work
sections.text: Pressure washing can be discussed as a one-time service or alongside landscaping and seasonal property care. Include the approximate area, the buildup you want addressed, and any access restrictions. The estimate is free and based on the actual job for your residential or commercial property.

faqs.q: Can I ask about several exterior surfaces?
faqs.a: Yes. List each surface and send photos if available. Eli can evaluate suitability and discuss which areas can be included in the estimate.

faqs.q: Can pressure washing be quoted with landscaping?
faqs.a: Yes. Select both services on the estimate form and describe the full scope. Availability and pricing are confirmed before work is scheduled.
